rendered: The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials, measured by ICP-OES, went down after delamination. The document reports it was reduced from 1.015[1] to 0.993 after delamination[2]. The authors attribute the drop most probably to lithium leaching in the delamination and washing steps[3]. The document does not state the unit for these values.
